_notes: lanePERF3 v100. Read by Scripts/PerfFixes.cs (+ FxPrewarm C1, GlbPreload C3, the flicker scripts D1/D1b). Each fix has its own enabled flag so the look gate can A/B them ONE AT A TIME. The shipped flags are look-neutral: the fixes that change what is drawn (A1, A1b, A4, B3) are false until the look gate passes them; C1 / C3 / D1 do not change the picture. Without a rebuild: -perffix:A1,A4 (only these on) | -perffix:none (baseline) | -noperffix:D1 (json minus these) | -perfharness (C1 / C3 also in harness runs). HDRP-asset fixes (A3 shadow depth bits 16, B3 decal atlas 2048 + asset draw distance 80) are NOT runtime: see asset_variants/make_variant.py (documented, not applied).

lights.name: DoorShadowWarm
lights.note: point 3000 cd, y 1.6, z 26, range 10, 512 soft shadow: static casters cached, fighters still drawn every frame (alwaysDrawDynamicShadows)

lights.name: DoorwayFlickerLight
lights.note: point 20000 cd, y 1.68, z 23.8, range 20, 512 soft shadow; its intensity flickers (DoorwayFlicker), intensity does not invalidate the cache, a moved transform would

A1b.note: A1 saves nothing if every prop counts as a dynamic caster: this marks MeshRenderers inside the light range as Renderer.staticShadowCaster so they go into the cached map. A moving MeshRenderer marked here would keep a FROZEN shadow: check the 'A1b staticCasters=' count in the log and the shadow of anything that moves (shards, rift, chains) in the look gate.

renderers.note: the arena floor plates (LOD0-2, scene object 'worldground_ground_paving_0'): a floor never shadows anything visible
terrain mesh; terrain_ground is already Off in the saved scene (laneSHADOW)
already Off in the scene, listed so a rebuilt scene keeps it Off

B3.note: RUNTIME half only: caps DecalProjector.drawDistance (never raises it). Scene decals are already 40 (decals.json projectorDefaults) and wound decals 25 (wounds.json decal.drawDistance), so this is a safety cap and changes nothing today. The real B3 change is in the HDRP asset (decalSettings.drawDistance 1000 -> 80, atlas 4096 -> 2048): asset_variants/make_variant.py --B3.

C1.note: FxPrewarm also builds + draws the MeshCut cap materials of each fighter body (sub-pixel, shadows on) and a throw-away severed-piece physics stub during the intro. Needs perf.json prewarm true and finishers.json enableFinishers + enableGore.

C3.note: GlbPreload parses the runtime-loaded gear glbs (gear.json items[].glb + files[]) with glTFast during the intro; GearAssetLoader takes the parsed import (hook: patches/GearAssetLoader_C3.py). Joan / Dracula / Pitborn bodies are imported assets of the scene and cannot be preloaded from code. Does nothing until the gear kit (GearAssetLoader) is merged.

D1.note: Flicker, DoorwayFlicker, AtmosFlicker, FurnaceFlicker (lights, emissive, fire rate), CrackFlicker: write a value only when it moved more than epsilon x its base since the last WRITE (0.002 = 0.2 pct, below what a gate can see). Set both to 0 for 'any change'.

D1b.note: CrackFlicker and FurnaceFlicker emissive via a per-renderer MaterialPropertyBlock instead of Material.SetColor on the shared material. A renderer with a property block drops out of the SRP Batcher: A/B it (it can be SLOWER with many renderers).
